_comment: Physical sites of establishments the Ministry of Health registry lists once (Owner decision 2026-11-15). Keyed by the establishment's record id. The first site places the establishment's own record; every further site becomes a record of its own, id {parent}-s{n}, carrying `site_of` and the parent's wilaya, commune, type and sector. The first site is not a claim that it is the headquarters, only that it is one of the establishment's real sites. lat/lng are the open OpenStreetMap object's point as read live from api.openstreetmap.org (osm, osm_version, osm_timestamp; a way's point is the centre of its bounding box), and that is the coordinate that ships, ODbL. Each point carries an owner_confirmation under docs/adr/0001 rule 6: an Owner reading off a proprietary map within 500 m confirms the open object and never ships. The build (scripts/sites.mjs) re-measures every distance and refuses a mismatch.

sites.why: The CHU's Khelil Amrane hospital, read live from api.openstreetmap.org on 2026-11-15. The record stood on the Bejaia commune centroid, 732 m away. The Owner's reading below is 216 m from the object, inside the 500 m ceiling.

owner_confirmation.note: A CONFIRMATION, never the published value. The Owner read the Google Maps pin of the CHU Bejaia site Khelil Amrane. The coordinate that ships is OpenStreetMap's.
